notes.title: New update will release soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35628567/507f28402d1aae8d7de9a3165f3ff474f93101ed.png[/img]
A new update for Crowd Simulator will be released soon. It tells the story of Mr.Robber after he got the safe in the supermarket. This update contains ten more exaggerated and funny crowded scenes. Mr.Robber's task is to travel with the safe, on the way will encounter all kinds of unexpected circumstances, in any case do not lose the safe.
